Name: belt_mg
Desc: A hundred linked rounds in a steel can. Feeds either hood gun.

Name: belt_50
Desc: Fifty linked .50 rounds in a can you need both hands for. Feeds the heavy gun.

Name: ac_shells
Desc: Twenty fat shells in a crate with rope handles.

Name: rocket
Desc: A tube with fins and a bad attitude. Fits the pods.

Name: heavy_rocket
Desc: One round for the big tube. Carry it like it is asleep.

Name: napalm
Desc: Jellied fuel. It sticks, and it keeps burning.

Name: rail_slug
Desc: Two pre-war tungsten slugs in foam. Nobody makes these any more.

Name: car_mine
Desc: A pressure plate on a cake tin of explosive. Do not step on it either.

Name: oil_drum
Desc: Black sludge drained from a hundred dead engines. Two slicks.

Name: smoke_can
Desc: Oil cut with tar for the smoke layer. Two clouds.

Name: flare_pack
Desc: Three magnesium flares and a striker.

Name: paint_can
Desc: White house paint, thinned for the sprayer.

Name: nitrous_bottle
Desc: A blue bottle that hisses. One burst.

Name: suppressant
Desc: A charge for the car's fire system.
